about.title: A Lesser Poland manufacturer built for professionals
about.lead: PROFIX was founded in 2007 in Skawina near Krakow, where our production facility still operates today. We make construction chemistry for the people who work with it every day: contractors, wholesalers, investors.
paragraphs: Our range covers cement-lime and gypsum plasters, adhesives, complete insulation systems, acrylic, silicone and latex paints, primers and supporting products.
We focus on repeatable quality and short lead times. Every product comes with full technical documentation, certificates and a declaration of conformity.

aboutPage.title: About PROFIX
aboutPage.subtitle: Construction chemistry manufacturer from Skawina
aboutPage.intro: PROFIX was founded in 2007 in Skawina near Krakow. Our production facility makes cement-lime and gypsum plasters, adhesives, insulation systems, acrylic, silicone and latex paints, primers and many other finishing and construction products.
aboutPage.mission: We keep adopting new technologies and improving the range. We work so that contractors keep coming back and investors can trust the result will last.
